notes.title: Knight`s Pride Release
notes.notes:
Hey guys! I am bringing you a new Game!

Have you enjoyed Knights and Dungeons?

Perhaps you would also enjoy Knight`s Pride!

Knight`s Pride is a different game tough....

Knight`s Pride plays almost like Knights and Dungeons, but in Knight`s Pride you are actually fighting the battles instead of letting it run on automatic.

Knight`s Pride was made on RPGmaker but* It has no story ok?? Because I am focusing on my audience
Wich is Idle incremental games.

Knight`s Pride is more like Incremental then Idle!

The game is very simple unlike most RPGS Knight`s Pride has very simple and basic mechanics like Knights and Dungeons.

So that means you can`t get lost or take hours learning how to play the game.

Knight`s pride is a paid game that cost around 3 dollars prices may be different in different regions.

Knight`s Pride also take 2 hours averagly to be beaten.

Do you enjoy doing repeatable tasks to unlock new progress??

Then perhaps Knight`s Pride is for you...

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Death Knight DLC release!
notes.notes:
Death Knight DLC is finally released on steam!

It brings on 60 new Dungeon Levels.
Ring slot that increases your wisdom.
And also a Death Knight Skin.

notes.title: Scientific numbers patch!
notes.notes:
Some of the attributes in the game will now be displayed as

100M = 100 million
100B = 100 Billion
100T = 100 Trillion
100Q = 100 Quadrllion


Lets see how this will evolve and work!

notes.title: New things in new patch!
notes.notes:
I made some adjustments....

Audio mute/unmute button should only appear on screen after menu appears as well. it will be inactive until then.

I changed the menu screen of the Orc fights to match the new model introduced in the latest patch.

I changed the font of enrgized from black to white.

I added more 60 dungeon levels since players are playing for longer then what I expected.


Thanks a bunch everyone!

notes.title: Fixed some bugs related to the patch!
notes.notes:
1. Ascend has been nerfed. It was too strong before.

2. You can no longer use the skills you havent learnt at the Academy

3. Fixed a gamebreaking bug that wouldnt let you click on anything after ascending.

notes.title: Mute-Unmute Patch!
notes.notes:
As title suggests I fixed Mute and Unmute function. 

Whenever you select the audio to to be mute now the game will be muted.

I also enlarged even more the dialogues and some texts so people can read it better.

notes.title: Cool Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys I decided to make some changes to the game in order to improve it.

Here they are:

1. Added character customization

2. You can now choose between 3 names

3. Fixed and adjusted swords and shields balance to match new Balance system

4. Enlarged some of the story texts so people can read better.

5. I believe the game now runs on the background, If it still does not then I am sorry.

6. Removed Save slots. I didnt manage to make them work decently

7. Bug fixes that kind of stuff.
